customManagers.description: Docker image pinned inside mise tasks (the mise manager only reads [tools]).

packageRules.description: Only third-party actions are SHA-pinned; actions/* stay on version tags.
@actual-app/api must match the user's Actual server version (and the e2e actual-server image). Review manually; update the README compatibility table.
Keep Node in lockstep between mise.toml and the Dockerfile base image.
pnpm bumps also require updating PNPM_VERSION and both PNPM_SHA256_* checksums in the Dockerfile.
